concerns.text: Tasks T095, T096, T097, and T098 in Phase 7 implement features (bond length constraints, FLOP error budgets, residual analysis, physical interpretability) that are explicitly marked as 'REMOVED' in Phase 8 and Phase 9 as 'scope creep'. This creates a direct contradiction where the task list includes work the project scope has already rejected, leaving the implementer unable to satisfy the 'removed' constraints while simultaneously being tasked to implement them.

Task T020a (Subset Selection) filters the dataset to only include molecules with existing optimized geometries BEFORE stratification. Spec US2 and FR-004 require a 'stratified random subset' of the *full dataset* to ensure a 'representative sample'. If convergence failures (US1 Edge Cases) remove a non-representative portion of the dataset, the resulting DFT subset will be biased, contradicting the spec's intent. There is no task to perform stratification on the full dataset first and then filter, or to handle the bias introduced by this order.

Task T022 (Evaluate Models) describes comparing Semi-Empirical RF and DFT RF models against each other. Spec SC-002 requires the MAE of both models to be measured against the *experimental barrier values* from the Zenodo dataset. While T022 mentions loading experimental data, the task description focuses on the inter-model comparison (paired t-test) rather than the explicit verification of accuracy against the experimental ground truth required by SC-002. A specific task to calculate and report MAE against experimental values is missing.

Phase 7 contains tasks (T095-T098) that are immediately contradicted by Phase 8 and 9 which state these exact items were 'REMOVED' as scope creep. This is a documentation inconsistency where the task list includes work the project scope has already rejected.
